opportunities.gap: The MDX body, Learning Targets, Opening Case logic, Core Concept, and Worked Example all reference WCAG 2.1 AA (lines 9, 13, 46), and practice items 1/2 and misconception feedback all say 'WCAG 2.1 AA'. WCAG 2.2 became a W3C Recommendation on 5 October 2023 (updated Dec 2024) and is the current standard as of 2026; WCAG 3.0 remains a Working Draft (March 2026) not expected to reach Recommendation before ~2028-2029.
